This earnings acceleration is further validated by the scanX signal engine, which identifies that profit growth is currently exceeding one-year price growth by 74% [E50]. Investors are currently ignoring this fundamental improvement, as the stock trades at a P/B of 1.26x [E1] and a P/E of 0x [E5], both of which represent a discount to sector benchmarks [E6]. While the long-term sales trajectory remains robust with 15% growth over ten years [E13] and 30% over five years [E14], the recent 17% growth in the trailing twelve months [E16] confirms that the business is successfully reversing its recent stagnation [E15].
